messages:
Rina M: Starting a compact follow-up thread for the postmortem action items from the regional failover. Need firm owners, short deadlines, and a single rehearsal plan. Key areas: route policy drift, backup verification, restore play halves (quick vs full), and recurring traffic surge analysis.
Tom S: I'll take route policy drift. Plan: run config-diff against golden, prepare cleanup PR, and add a daily lint to catch future drift. ETA: 3 business days.
Asha K: Backup verification owner here. Will add a smoke restore job in sandbox and fail CI if restore fails twice. Draft PR by Tue.
Diego F: I'll rewrite the restore playbook into a Quick Recovery section (<=15m) and a Full Restore appendix. Quick Recovery draft by Wed.
Rina M: For the rehearsal: 45m tabletop exercising quick recovery + route flip. Prefer Thu 10:30. I'll create channel and invite SRE + netops.
tracker-bot: Created ticket DR-8892 (route-drift-cleanup) and DR-8893 (backup-smoke-restore) and linked to tracker: https://intra.redwood/trackers/dr-889x
Tom S: One note: need permission to run route-dryrun tool in staging. @infra-team can you approve a short-lived role?
Asha K: Found 2 failed eu-west snapshots in logs. Adding checksum details to DR-8893.
Diego F: Tabletop script outline: detection -> alert -> fail traffic -> quick-restore -> verify. Will post script by Wed morning.
Rina M: Great. Owners & ETAs recap: routing -> Tom (3d), backup smoke -> Asha (PR Tue, script Fri), restore playbook -> Diego (draft Wed), tabletop -> Rina (Thu 10:30). Update tracker if dates slip.
Tom S: Marking route-lint as a recurring weekly job in the tracker.
Rina M: Thanks everyone 10: I'll follow up after the rehearsal with a short remediation summary and next steps.
